description_md:
## Follow the Brookhaven family trail

Start with the family portraits and movie-code scenes, then compare them with signed notes around town. Mr. Brookhaven, Madison, and Marcus appear in different places, so following their relationships helps connect clues that look unrelated at first.

Marcus is linked to Agency puzzles, but his exact loyalty is not settled. His FBI uniform and short messages are evidence to examine, not a free pass to promote a theory into canon.

## Read Agency messages carefully

Greed is associated with the Agency, hidden rooms, and the conflict with Mr. Brookhaven. Some messages fit Greed's story because of their location and themes, but unsigned writing should stay attributed cautiously.

The signature Mr. B is also unresolved. It may refer to Mr. Brookhaven, but the clues do not prove that identity, so treat it as a possible alias instead of a separate confirmed person.

## Separate named figures from secret identities

Brave appears by name in portraits, messages, and quest clues. Those clues establish the figure's symbolic role, but they do not reveal a civilian identity hiding behind the name.
